source.comment: Struggled home at Werribee two back. Outclassed when down the track when first-up at Casterton. Looking to others.
Resuming (20 weeks). Raced back but caught the eye late at Cranbourne last start. Won a recent Caulfield Heath jumpout and worth including.
Crowded and checked near the 200m at Kembla Grange two back. Raced three wide when placed at Warracknabeal last start. Keep safe.
Resuming (68 weeks). Settled rearward on debut at Mt Gambier. Third in a recent Casterton jumpout and the rise to 1100m may help.
$60k yearling out of a stakes-performed mare who has produced three winners. Ran second at a recent Geelong jumpout and can measure up.
Overraced early when well beaten at Kilmore two back. Beaten out of sight at Casterton first run back. Prefer others.
First foal to race out of a placed mare. Won her latest Burrumbeet jumpout and worth keeping an eye on.
Keen when fifth at Bendigo two back. Laid out in the straight at Warrnambool last start. Others more appealing here.
Out of a multiple city-winning mare. Ran third at his latest Caulfield Heath jumpout and looks suitably placed here.
Beaten a long distance at Sandown Hillside two back. Fought hard at Warracknabeal first run back. Can run a bold race here second-up.

source.comment: Won well here two back before running on strongly to win at Wangaratta last start. Can complete the hat-trick.
source.lastGear: Cross-over Nose Band OFF, Tongue Tie OFF

source.comment: Led and battled on gamely to win at Mildura last start. Looks hard to hold out on current form.
Resuming (17 weeks). Dictated terms and won well at Horsham before the break. Can be competitive fresh in this line-up.
source.lastGear: Blinkers OFF, Cross-over Nose Band OFF

source.comment: Resuming (10 weeks). Pulled up lame at Ballarat Synthetic before the break. Won a Casterton jumpout since and can improve.
Freshened (32 days). Held up near the 500m at Bairnsdale two back. Tried hard at Moe last start. One for the exotics.
Held up near the 400m at Casterton first run back. Strips fitter second-up and can run a bold race here.
source.lastGear: Cross-over Nose Band ON, Nose Roll OFF, Winkers ON

source.comment: Resuming (19 weeks). Raced wide without cover at Donald last start. Ran fourth at a Casterton jumpout since and looks ready to fire fresh.
source.lastGear: Compression Hood With Ear Muffs OFF

source.comment: Checked near the 100m at Warrnambool first run back. Well beaten when first-up at Ballarat two back. Should be sharper second-up.
Resuming (25 weeks, ex C Maher). Kept grinding away at Goulburn last start. Had two jumpouts and drops in grade fresh.
source.lastGear: Cross-over Nose Band OFF, Ear Muffs (Pre-Race Only) ON, Lugging Bit OFF, Tongue Tie OFF

source.comment: Pressed forward but couldn't keep going at Ballarat Synthetic two back. Beaten a long distance there last start. Needs to find plenty more.
Fractious in the barriers at Warracknabeal two back. Keen and held up when runner-up at Casterton last start. Meets a stronger bunch here.
source.lastGear: Cross-over Nose Band ON, Pacifiers OFF, Winkers ON

source.comment: Raced three wide at Werribee two back. Failed to handle the going at Geelong first run back. Better for the run second-up.
Tried hard when runner-up at Naracoorte two back. Caught the eye late at Warrnambool last start. Needs to lift again here.
Settled rearward at Mt Gambier two back. Whacked away at Casterton when first-up. Prefer others in this.

source.comment: Won with authority at Casterton last start after racing on speed. Can feature prominently in this race again.
Finished off strongly to win here two back. Settled rearward when first-up. Worth another go here.
Resuming (22 weeks). Ordered to trial when winning at Werribee before the break. Second in two recent jumpouts and can go on with it now.
Laid in the straight when narrowly beaten at Naracoorte last start. Maps well and can go one better here.
Let-up (46 days). Beaten a long distance at Ballarat Synthetic two back. Laid out in the straight at Bendigo last start. Can improve here.
Battled away solidly at Mildura two back. Pace-setter but weakened at Ballarat Synthetic last start. Can fill a minor placing third-up.
Raced wide without cover at Seymour last start. Winkers go on and drops in grade. One for the wider exotics.
Tail-ender two back and has plenty to find on recent form. Left trailing miles back at Warrnambool last start.
Freshened (36 days). Mounting yard incident here two back. Battled away at Casterton last start. Hard to trust here.
Resuming (11 weeks). Trailed the field throughout at Bordertown before the break. Needs to find plenty more to figure in this line-up.
Handy but walked home late at Ballarat Synthetic two back. Whacked away there last start. Needs to find plenty more here.
